dedupe_keys.name: bornes et poteaux d incendie du pays ajaccien

description: Bornes et poteaux d’incendie du pays Ajaccien is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CAPA-Communauté d'Agglomération du Pays Ajaccien. Géolocalisation des bornes et poteaux d’incendie situés sur le territoire du Pays Ajaccien. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Territory & Development. Its keywords are bornes, incendie. The portal shows 353 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-11-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
